dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 5 prominent 'O' shaped structures on the posterior dorsal region show irregular elliptical perimeters with a soft gradient transition from dark grey outer boundaries to lighter interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters located between the larger macro-annuli, with a higher concentration near the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest annuli on the upper posterior flank form a scalene triangle, while a group of four smaller markings on the lower flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt spatial transition from a dark, non-patterned anterior region to a densely patterned posterior region at the approximate mid-point of the visible torso.
